skill.name: invoice-winning-numbers
skill.description: 從財政部電子發票整合服務平台查統一發票最新中獎號碼並對獎，支援批次對獎、雲端發票專屬獎（PDF 清單）、歷史期別查詢與每期自動對獎流程。發票對獎、統一發票、中獎號碼、特別獎、特獎、頭獎、增開六獎、雲端發票專屬獎、兌獎期限的問題適用。免 API 金鑰、免登入。發票以外的稅務申報、記帳問題不適用。
skill.summary: Check Taiwan invoice numbers against official prize lists, with batch matching, cloud prize checks, and period-specific claim information.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: The 19 backtick alerts, eight URL alerts, and two entropy alerts are false positives involving Markdown, official public sources, and readable multilingual text. Seven temporary-file alerts identify predictable shared paths that permit local tampering or symlink-based overwrites. Automatic rechecking also lacks explicit consent and can misuse carrier suffixes or reuse invoice numbers across periods; no credential exfiltration evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Predictable shared temporary paths permit file replacement and symlink-based overwrites.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private directory with mktemp -d, keep downloads and converted text inside it, and remove it after processing.

remediation.issue: Automatic rechecking can retain invoice identifiers and create recurring actions without explicit user consent.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval for scheduling and retention, define expiry, and provide cancellation and deletion controls.

remediation.issue: Carrier suffixes cannot identify invoices, and saved invoice numbers can produce invalid matches in later periods.
remediation.suggestion: Require complete invoice identifiers and issue periods; reject carrier suffixes as matching inputs and process each invoice only for its period.

content.value_statement: Checking Taiwan invoices manually can miss prize matches or use the wrong draw period. This skill guides official-source lookups, batch comparisons, and cloud prize verification.
actual_capabilities: Download the latest official winning-number page without an API key or login.
Parse draw periods and prize numbers while handling digits split across HTML tags.
Compare individual or batch invoice numbers against full-number and suffix-based prize rules.
Check complete cloud invoice serials against prize-specific PDF lists using pdftotext.
Retrieve historical cloud prize links and provide official links for historical regular draws.
Report the draw period, prize result, source URL, and claim window with verification caveats.
limitations: Network access, curl, and Python 3 are required; cloud PDF extraction also requires pdftotext.
Historical regular winning numbers require manual confirmation on the JavaScript-rendered tax portal.
Page changes can break parsing, and estimated claim deadlines require official confirmation.
No scheduler or carrier-account access is included; carrier suffixes cannot identify invoices, and recurring checks need explicit consent.

use_cases.title: Check Household Receipts
use_cases.description: Compare several receipts from one draw period and report each highest matching prize.

use_cases.title: Verify Cloud Invoice Prizes
use_cases.description: Check complete cloud invoice serials against official PDF lists and confirm the prize category from each document header.

use_cases.title: Review Historical Draw Sources
use_cases.description: Locate official historical draw references and distinguish downloadable cloud prize lists from regular draws needing manual confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Latest Draw
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the latest Taiwan invoice winning numbers. Include the draw period, official source, and claim window. Mark any estimated deadline.

prompt_templates.title: Check Several Invoices
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [eight-digit invoice numbers] for [issue period]. Preserve leading zeros. Report each highest prize and verify the draw period before comparing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Batch comparison for a known period

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Cloud Invoice
prompt_templates.prompt: Check cloud invoice [two-letter prefix and eight digits] for [issue period]. Use official PDF lists and confirm full-serial matches and prize headers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Approved Recheck
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan one recheck for [invoice numbers and issue period] after its draw. Ask before scheduling or retaining identifiers, and specify expiry and cancellation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow planning with an external scheduler

best_practices: Preserve leading zeros and verify each invoice's issue period before matching.
Use fresh official sources and confirm claim deadlines and cloud prize document headers.
Use private temporary storage and obtain explicit approval before retaining identifiers or scheduling recurring checks.
anti_patterns: Treating historical examples, cached pages, or estimated deadlines as current official results.
Matching carrier suffixes or partial cloud serials as though they were complete invoice identifiers.
Rechecking saved numbers across unrelated periods or creating recurring tasks without explicit permission.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or login?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow downloads public official pages and prize PDFs without credentials.

faq.question: Can I check several invoices together?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes batch comparison guidance and reports the highest matching prize for each invoice.

faq.question: What is needed for cloud invoice prizes?
faq.answer: Provide the full two-letter prefix and eight digits. Cloud prizes require exact serial matches and eligibility confirmation.

faq.question: Can it retrieve historical winning numbers?
faq.answer: Historical cloud prize lists are downloadable. Historical regular draws require manual confirmation through official tax-portal links.

faq.question: Does it automatically schedule future checks?
faq.answer: No scheduler is included. Scheduled checks require external tooling, explicit approval, identifier retention limits, and correct issue-period matching.

faq.question: What happens if a page cannot be parsed?
faq.answer: The instructions require stopping and directing you to the official site. The skill should not invent results or present stale data.
